summary: Allbirds, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026, to disclose an increase in the maximum aggregate offering price of its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program from an unspecified prior amount by an additional $48.1 million. The shares are sold through Chardan Capital Markets LLC as sales agent under a Sales Agreement, registered on a Form S-3 shelf (333-288434). This is a routine capital-raising activity, not a special situation; the filing updates the registration capacity and includes legal opinions. No deal terms beyond the $48.1M increase are stated. Watch for actual issuance pace and dilution.
